documents.text: # Ayushman Bharat – Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY)

## 1. Overview
Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY) is a centrally sponsored scheme. It provides a health cover of ₹5 lakhs per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization across public and private empaneled hospitals in India.

## 2. Target Beneficiaries
The scheme targets over 12 crore poor and vulnerable entitled families (approximately 50 crore beneficiaries) across the country.

## 3. Eligibility and Inclusion Criteria
The scheme does not have an enrollment process. It is an entitlement-based scheme. Families included are based on the deprivation and occupational criteria of the Socio-Economic Caste Census 2011 (SECC 2011) for rural and urban areas respectively.

**General Income Criteria for Auto-Inclusion (Proxy):**
Households with an annual family income of less than ₹3,00,000 are generally considered within the deprivation criteria, though exact inclusion is strictly mapped against the SECC database.

There is NO cap on family size, age, or gender.

## 4. Key Benefits
- Provides ₹5 Lakhs per family, per year.
- Covers up to 3 days of pre-hospitalization and 15 days of post-hospitalization expenses such as diagnostics and medicines.
- Cashless and paperless access to services at the point of care.
- Pre-existing diseases are covered from day one.

## 5. Required Documents at Hospital
Beneficiaries need to prove their identity at the empaneled hospital using:
- Aadhaar Card
- Ration Card (for family mapping)
- Income Certificate (if verification is required by state mandate)
# Official Gazette: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)

## 1. Objective
The Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN) aims to provide income support to all landholding farmer families across the country to enable them to take care of expenses related to agriculture and allied activities as well as domestic needs.

## 2. Benefits
Under the Scheme, an income support of ₹6,000/- per year is provided to all eligible farmer families. The amount is transferred in three equal installments of ₹2,000/- each, every four months directly into the bank accounts of the beneficiaries.

## 3. Eligibility Criteria
All landholding farmers' families, which have cultivable landholding in their names, are eligible to get benefit under the scheme.
A landholding farmer's family is defined as "a family comprising of husband, wife and minor children who own cultivable land as per land records of the concerned State/UT".

## 4. Exclusions
The following categories of beneficiaries of higher economic status shall not be eligible for benefit under the scheme:
a) All Institutional Land holders.
b) Farmer families in which one or more of its members belong to following categories:
   i) Former and present holders of constitutional posts.
   ii) Former and present Ministers/ State Ministers and former/present Members of Lok Sabha/ Rajya Sabha/ State Legislative Assemblies/ State Legislative Councils, former and present Mayors of Municipal Corporations, former and present Chairpersons of District Panchayats.
   iii) All serving or retired officers and employees of Central/ State Government Ministries /Offices/Departments and its field units Central or State PSEs and Attached offices /Autonomous Institutions under Government as well as regular employees of the Local Bodies (Excluding Multi Tasking Staff /Class IV/Group D employees).
   iv) All superannuated/retired pensioners whose monthly pension is ₹10,000/- or more (Excluding Multi Tasking Staff / Class IV/Group D employees).
   v) All Persons who paid Income Tax in last assessment year.
   vi) Professionals like Doctors, Engineers, Lawyers, Chartered Accountants, and Architects registered with Professional bodies and carrying out profession by undertaking practices.

## 5. Required Documents
- Aadhaar Card
- Proof of Citizenship
- Documents demonstrating ownership of land (Land Proof)
- Details of bank account

## 1. Scheme Objective
To provide a pucca house with basic amenities to all houseless households and those households living in kutcha and dilapidated house in rural areas by 2024.

## 2. Benefits
- Financial assistance of ₹1.20 lakh in plain areas and ₹1.30 lakh in hilly states, difficult areas, and IAP districts.
- Beneficiary is also entitled to 90/95 person-days of unskilled labor wage under MGNREGA.
- An additional assistance of ₹12,000 is provided for the construction of toilets under Swachh Bharat Mission-Gramin (SBM-G).

## 3. Identification of Beneficiaries
Identification of beneficiaries is based on the housing deprivation parameters of Socio-Economic and Caste Census (SECC), 2011, subject to 13-point exclusion criteria, followed by Gram Sabha verification.

Households that are completely houseless or living in zero, one, or two room houses with kutcha wall and kutcha roof are eligible.

## 4. Exclusion Criteria
Households are excluded if they have:
- Motorized two/three/four wheelers / agricultural equipment.
- Kisan Credit Card with a credit limit of ₹50,000 or above.
- Any member as a government employee.
- Households with non-agricultural enterprises registered with the government.
- Any member of the family earning more than ₹10,000 per month.
- Paying income tax or professional tax.
- Owning a refrigerator or landline phone.
- Owning 2.5 acres or more of irrigated land with at least one irrigation equipment.

## 5. Documents
- Aadhaar Card
- Bank Account Details
- Swachh Bharat Mission (SBM) number (if available)
- MGNREGA Job Card number (if available)
- Land Proof (document showing ownership of land where house is to be constructed)
- Income Certificate
